title: AirPods Pro 3 Wireless Earbuds, Active Noise Cancellation $299 (RRP $429) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: AirPods Pro 3 Wireless Earbuds, Active Noise Cancellation $299 (RRP $429) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[19199090] My pro 2s are still holding on but I’m tempted
[sunbro] Same. Bought it at launch. Still going strong and been used heavily - work, home, travel, running.
I’ve had several occasions where I’ve dropped a single earbud and accidentally left it behind then I think “damn gotta buy a new one”. But find my always leads me to the lost AirPod.
[BiggieSmalls] My original pro’s are still holding on pretty well. I see no reason to change but price is tempting for sure.
[tarantuula] I have the pro 3s. They're great but one might come out next year + 3s have QC issues that the 2 didn't really have (lots of complaints about the ANC quality deteriorating over time).
My ones have a bad robotic mic which apple didn't replace despite going to the store twice as they said it's normal (the 2s mic I compared to had a much nicer sound). The worker at the store recommended I accidentally run these through the wash and replace them for $45 (with AppleCare) if I wanted peace of mind :O
ANC for me is leagues better than the Momentum 4 I previously owned and sound quality is on par with my KZ PRX and HD599SE (but note that all three are different earbud/headphone categories)
Also, I bought from TechCiti where they said they were AU stock but I went to Apple and they confirmed it was Singapore stock. While still certified for Australia (and other countries) all the packing was in Malaysian. Amazon or local retailer price match is safest :)
[Panama] Great buds. Where can i get official tip replacements?
[Arkhxm] Easy enough to google and see Apple has them
[bictory] can use with https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/978694 , EDR, min cashback on SB/TCB
[jlogic] For those thinking about upgrading from APP 2. The sound profile hs changed on the APP 3 to be slightly V shaped on the Harman curve than the 2. So boomier bass and brighter treble… if that is what you prefer. Too brighter treble for me leads to too much hissing, but I do prefer boomier bass.
[matthewpoon] Thought I had the APP2's, but turned out I've still been rocking 1's. Thanks for the post. Copped! :)
[iDrownFish] Has anyone found more comfortable replacement ear tips for these? the app2's were much softer
[micm1991] Coming up as $399 for me when I log in. Any thoughts?
[matthewpoon] Not sure. Still coming up as $299 for me.
[FujinShu] Apparently APP3 sound is worse than APP2?
[triggerr] Thanks OP! Was waiting for sub 300. Got my Pro 2s at launch and battery/ANC has been deteriorating rapidly recently
[musai] pro 4 will be out early next year and pro 3 ANC will be deteriorating rapidly after some magic update.
[Frozensage] finally sub 299, can claim it instantly on wfh
